current_evidence: The council's 'Submit a planning application' page links only this 'Planning application validation checklist (PDF, 1.19MB)'; the document says it was adopted at Planning Committee on 11 July 2024 (v.6).

issues.detail: The source has a Part 4 section with a checklist for each application type (Advert, Householder, Full, Hedgerow, LBC, NMA, Outline, Demolition in CA, Reserved Matters, Discharge, Variation, LDC, PiP, Technical Details Consent, Prior Approvals, Works to Trees). Grokbot ignored it: about 45 requirements are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' and most other types are marked '(none) - national requirements only'. Under Householder it lists only 'Employment / Economic Statement', whose own trigger excludes householders.
issues.evidence: Part 4: Application Types; Economic Statement trigger: 'Required for major developments, excluding householders which are major development by virtue of site area.'

issues.detail: Grokbot did not capture these Part 3 local requirements: Affordable Housing (11+ units or 1,000 sqm+ residential), Broadband Statement (residential of 10+ units), Coal Mining Risk Assessment (Coal Authority High Risk Area), Climate Change Statement (all new buildings except householder), Construction Management Plan (major development with significant construction traffic, e.g. solar farms), External Lighting details (all floodlighting proposals), Green Belt Impact Assessment (new buildings, replacements, extensions and engineering in the Green Belt, including householder extensions), Health Impact Assessment (over 50 dwellings or other major development with significant health impacts), Rights of Way, Tourism Need Statement, Highway Information (all new residential) and Wind Turbine information.

Most 'Submission rules' and 'Local forms' tab_items are process text, contact details or privacy boilerplate, not requirements: the 21- and 7-working-day invalid-application procedure, 'telephone customer services on 01636 650000 ... duty planner', the GDPR and personal-information paragraphs, 'download a printable flood map', 'Environment Agency: o0411btqm-e-e.pdf ... 32 | P a g e 29.', and 'This will ensure our Checklist is up to date'.
issues.evidence: tab_items section 'Submission rules' (11 items) and 'Local forms / checklists'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are fragments rather than the trigger: Planning Statement 'Threshold/Trigger Required for' (cut off); Structural Survey 'Institution of Structural Engineers or equivalent).'; Sunlight to gardens 'gardens or amenity space.'; BNG 'pay. 4|Page Biodiversity Net Gain...'; Drainage 'a Foul Drainage Assessment Form should be completed.' (the source requires drainage information for all major applications and any that could increase flood risk); Arboricultural 'Tree surveys shall include ... BS 5837:2012' (content, not trigger); Contaminated Land 'there are some circumstances...' (the source names allocated sites and listed contaminative uses).
issues.evidence: Drainage trigger in source: 'All major applications; applications that could increase flood risk'

issues.detail: The 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' row uses the Agricultural Land Classification/Soil Testing trigger. The source's Agricultural Justification item applies to new, replacement or temporary rural workers' dwellings and extensions to them.
issues.evidence: Part 3 item 2 Agricultural Justification vs item 3 Agricultural Land Classification

issues.detail: 'CIL Additional Information / Form' and 'Self-build / custom build information' use the same CIL self-build exemption excerpt. 'Employment / Economic Statement' appears under both Householder and Full planning. The drawing-standards tab_items repeat the same 'Plans should ... 1:50 or 1:100' text 5 times with list letters left in ('a. b. c. d.').
The list date is recorded as 2024-07-01, but the document gives the adoption date as 11 July 2024.

summary: Grokbot's link is the current list (adopted 11 July 2024), but the extraction is poor. It ignores the per-application-type checklists in Part 4, misses about 12 local requirements, and fills the tab with procedure and contact text and broken trigger fragments.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
